description_expanded: This multi-level 30A vacation home with a wraparound deck includes four bedrooms and accommodations for ten beach-loving guests, plus your pup, as it pet-friendly! It has an outstanding lakefront location in Dune Allen Beach , with convenient beach access only minutes away. The driveway crosses a captivating bridge to the home’s enchanting lakefront setting. It overlooks Oyster Lake , a rare coastal dune lake found hardly anywhere else in the world. These lakes have an exotic mix of artisan spring-fed and salted water created by regular tidal action from a tributary that connects to the gulf. It provides an abundant habitat for wildlife, fish, and waterfowl. This gracious home also features a lagoon-shaped  15' x 34’  private swimming   pool, a bubbling hot tub, and a spacious sun patio overlooking the lake. Upon arrival, Rising Tide includes an attractive terracotta-colored paver stone driveway with ample parking. An open staircase leads to an expansive sun deck with views of the glittering gulf. The wraparound deck also faces the lovely lake and provides an excellent entertainment area for drinks and dining. Inside, the open living and dining room include a partially vaulted ceiling and beach-washed vinyl plank flooring. The handsome living area boasts a white leather couch and love seat beside an oval cocktail table facing a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV. The charming dining area includes a rustic cottage-styled hardwood table and six crisscross-backed chairs providing a beachy look. The kitchen features brushed stainless steel appliances and honey-toned custom cabinetry richly accented by streaked brown granite countertops for the household chef. The bright primary bedroom features contemporary coastal furnishings with a king-size bed that faces a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV for nighttime viewing pleasure. It also has views of the glittering gulf in the distance through French doors flanked by two side windows that lead out to the balcony. The ensuite bath includes a tub-shower combination. Another full hall bath with a tub shower combination is reserved for the other guest quarters and serves as a powder room. Two of these bedrooms have comfortable king-sized beds, while the other is great for the kids with two twin bunk beds. Each bedroom also includes a wall-mounted flatscreen TV for evening entertainment. This incredible Dune Allen Beach locale is a short drive away from popular restaurants, friendly bars with live music, grocery stores, and exciting shopping adventures. The acclaimed Santa Rosa Beach village center of Gulf Place is only two minutes away. It includes restaurants, casual bars, a coffee shop, fashion boutiques, specialty shops, and galleries. A grassy lawn amphitheater lined with palm trees at its center hosts outdoor concerts, art shows, and fun seasonal festivals. Popular restaurants like Vue on 30A and Stinky’s Fish Camp are also within walking distance. Vue on 30A serves Caribbean-styled seafood with a Gulf Coast flair and has heavenly views of the glowing gulf from its dune top location. Despite its whimsical name, Stinky’s Fish Camp serves fantastic fresh-caught gulf fish, oysters, craft beer, and wine. First Floor: Garage (Non-Accessible), Exterior Stairs. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo and Balcony Access, King Bedroom, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, King Bedroom, Bunk Room with Two Twin Bunks, Laundry. *Add $50.00 per day to heat the pool & hot tub (available Oct-April if needed).
